race.comment: SWITCHBLADE (8) was there on straightening but just whacked away to finish a distant third last time out over 1710m at this circuit. Has scored over this track and trip before - should enjoy the shorter journey and in a raced decimated by scratchings he gets his chance. THE TORQUE FACTOR (3) wound up late and got very close on the line when resuming over 1200m at Grafton recently. Lightly raced five-year-old who will be hard to hold out over a bit more ground this time. HIDDEN FUTURE (14) returned to form last start when runner-up over this course and distance. Saves her best for Ipswich so keep her in mind. ZOUSLAYER (17) caught the eye at the Sunshine Coast on Sunday and cannot be ruled out on the quick back-up. MISHANI UNDERCOVER (23) is back in a more suitable race today and is in the mix on a nine-day turnaround.
